title: Added a PSX corporate announcements corpus
points: Added a deterministic pipeline step for ticker-specific PSX corporate announcements, separate from annual and quarterly filing pages.
The new corpus downloads all PSX announcement attachment formats, parses them to markdown with Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, and publishes searchable rows to `psx_announcements` and `psx_announcements_fts`.

Announcement `search_text` now mirrors the filing-page BM25 contract: compact ticker/date/title/status/summary discovery text, while parsed markdown is stored separately in bounded `text` rows and full local markdown artifacts.
Published the January 1, 2026 through June 24, 2026 announcement corpus to D1: 8,847 searchable rows across 553 tickers and 118 dates, with matching FTS rows.
Persistent Gemini parse failures are kept in local coverage artifacts and skipped from D1 by default; the current backfill skipped 118 failed attachments after retries.
